phone.changelog:
• Watch Face Creator Studio: Frame simulator (Titanium Ultra, Steel, Matte Black), interactive live ticking & sensor test bench, dark photo tinting, hand styles & complication designs
• 50+ Curated Watch Faces in Online Store across Luxury, Sports, Cyberpunk, Retro, Minimal, and Art
• 5 Native Interactive Watch Faces: Orbit Pro, Chrono Ultra, Retro Illuminator, Cyberpunk HUD, and Bauhaus Minimal
• Instant 1-tap update execution and shared ViewModel state across Settings and Device screens

watch.changelog:
• 5 Pre-installed Native Interactive Watch Faces: Orbit Pro (activity rings), Chrono Ultra (live subdials), Retro Illuminator (vintage LCD with cyan backlight), Cyberpunk HUD (animated ECG pulse & 4 neon color themes), and Bauhaus Minimal (Swiss glance dial)
• Interactive touch features on dials: backlight glow, theme cycling, glance mode toggle
• Full compatibility with HSWF dynamic face engine and live complication streaming
